Unless I'm misunderstanding your suggestion here, I don't think this would work. I ran into an issue with the callback that I described here: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/106947#issuecomment-2933473765

Essentially, when a nested resource (like a texture on a material) was changed, the inspector tree would be rebuilt, and the object with the callback would be destroyed. As a result, the callback could only be executed once per opening of the Quick Load window. This was fine for the old behavior since the window would be closed upon selecting a resource, but with the new behavior where the same window remains open, it'd result in [later selections not doing anything as Calinou noticed](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/106947#pullrequestreview-2890325740).
The callback can be called once you press Enter, not when selecting.
